0.why: Omen.cpp:84 clockTrigger.process(inputs[CLOCK_INPUT].getVoltage()) with rack's default SchmittTrigger thresholds, so a rising edge is detected past 1V and the jack is armed again below 0V; read at voltages[0] with no channel loop

1.why: Omen.cpp:88 resetTrigger.process(inputs[RESET_INPUT].getVoltage()) with rack's default SchmittTrigger thresholds, so a rising edge is detected past 1V and the jack is armed again below 0V; read at voltages[0] with no channel loop

comment: The seed is built at Omen.cpp:137-145 by exclusive-oring each button's state, one to six, shifted three bits per button, so the six buttons make the seed between them rather than each owning a part of it. The clock count is a plain counter of rising edges (line 85) and nothing in the plugin measures tempo from it, which is why the 24 pulses per quarter note matter: a Kron division is that many counts.
